title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Tokyo Dome City Hall, Tokyo | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Tokyo Dome City Hall in Tokyo, Japan, on 5 April 2019.

It was the seventh show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019, and the first of three consecutive nights at the Tokyo Dome City Hall.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘What Goes On’

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
